thread:
maria g: Seeing a weird spike in 413s on /embeddings when clients send ~100 vectors @1536 dims but overall payload is small. Any ideas on splitter/routing behavior?
chetan: Is this the new 6MB 413 threshold hitting? We tightened that last week.
sara: The splitter is still bytes-first. We don't inspect dims for preflight decisions today.
maria g: Strange — 100 * 1536 * 4 ~ 600KB raw, even with json overhead shouldn't hit 6MB. Some clients encode extra metadata though.
phil: example request (redacted):
```json
{"vectors": [[...100 vectors...]], "meta": {"user_notes": "..."}}
```
phil: headers: `X-Vector-Dims: 1536`, `Content-Type: application/json`
aleks: If the preflight can't detect dims it will conservatively split by bytes which can cause fragmentation + retries and then a 413 on the assembled envelope.
maria g: Console telemetry gave us request ids but no reason code for splitting — we couldn't tell why it chose path A vs B.
ux-rey: Could we emit a small set of tags per request: `prefight.dim_detected`, `split_reason`, `chosen_route`? UX needs that to explain to customers in the console.
chetan: +1. Also useful: `split_count`, `post-split-bytes`, and `prefilter_time_ms` histogram.
sara: Proposed changes: 1) plumb `X-Vector-Dims` into preflight so splitter can prefer dim-aware routes; 2) emit `embed.preflight.outcome` event with tags: dims, bytes, split_count, route, reason_code; 3) add console panel: split-rate by model/dims and top error reasons.
phil: For (1) we should validate header shape. Example header handling: `X-Vector-Dims: 1536` -> int parse, fallback to bytes heuristic if missing.
aleks: Also think about quota semantics: if we split a logical 100-vector request into 3 shards, billing/quotas should count the original 100 vectors, not shards. Need deterministic split_id to avoid double counting on retries.
maria g: Good point. Currently quota is charged on the outbound shard. That leads to variance.
chetan: Implementation plan: preflight dims flag (FF: `preflight-dims-heuristic`). Start at 1% traffic, collect telemetry, then 25%, then 100%. Telemetry to include trace_id and `split_policy` tag.
ux-rey: For console design: show a single request trace that explains decision tree: preflight -> dims present? -> chosen route -> split_count -> quota attribution. Keep it collapsible.
sara: I'll own the telemetry event schema. Draft shape: `embed.preflight.outcome` fields: `trace_id`, `customer_id`, `model`, `dims`, `payload_bytes`, `split_count`, `route`, `reason_code`, `duration_ms`.
phil: Add an internal-only boolean `heuristic_applied` so we can A/B regressions.
aleks: Also add `split_id` deterministic from hash(customer_id + request_id + dims) so retries reuse same id.
devops-bot: Note: deploy window requested for canary: eng-platform/preflight-dims @ 03:00 UTC. CI: must include unit tests for header parsing.
chetan: I'll open the PR with flag, telemetry emission, and quota adjustment hooks. Assign console panel to sara and UX notes to ux-rey.
maria g: Thanks. Once PR is up, let's run a 2-day canary and monitor split_rate, 413 rate, and per-request latency p50/p95. Sync tomorrow 11:00 for rollout go/no-go.
